name: necromancer
description: Necromancer dev agent – runs tests after every src file save.

postToolUse.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); PATH_VAL=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"path\",\"\"))"); if echo "$PATH_VAL" | grep -q "/src/"; then npm test; fi'
